prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "Select whether to create a custom companion from your photo or pick from instant ready-to-play species.", "Select Path"]
1: ["Design Your Companion", "Customize species, traits, and personality style before finalize adoption.", "Personality & Style Presets", "Live Companion View"]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Click and drag to move your pet. Right-click for settings or to hide your pet anytime.", "Start Exploring", "Quick Controls: Drag to move | Right-click to hide | Double-click to chat"]
3: []
4: ["Rendering pet assets and setting up desktop overlay...", "Status: Desktop display subsystem initialized"]
5: ["Signing in secures your adoption history and keeps your pet persistent across device restarts.", "Safe Sync: Pet data permanently attached to your account"]
6: ["Official Desktop Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion design is verified and ready to spawn on your desktop screen.", "Verified Companion Asset", "Final Companion Preview"]
7: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion", "In less than 2 minutes, create a custom virtual companion that lives directly on your Windows or Mac desktop screen.", "Begin Setup"]
8: []
9: ["Unlocked: First Desktop Pet Starter Accessories", "Pro Tips: Use Alt+P to quickly hide/show your desktop pet anytime!"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requesting a photo of the user.
